notes.title: Future update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've been working hard on the game lately. The next update will take the game in a whole new direction—one that feels much more polished. I can't wait for you to experience it!

A lot of work has been done on the UI, thanks to a talented artist.

As a sneak peek, here are some screenshots from the upcoming update:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490341/58a1dd60cafe08144eabc7e62c92f1944a2fc9ec.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490341/f34aff75bbef1c619fca102cec8e7bc81f3d88f4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490341/26ab4484ed0199e42687b9dce2cf7b09b4216ffe.png[/img]

What do you think ?
